regeneration.summary: Active hero is a v2 regeneration. The v1 hero (rejected/img_v1-selfreview-rejected.jpg) was rejected in Cora's self-review: v1 pieces read as long breaded chicken tenders.
regeneration.prompt_change: v2 prompt = v1 prompt verbatim plus one 'Regeneration clarifier:' sentence inserted before the quality-reference sentence. See the 'Regeneration v2 prompt addition' section of image-prompt.md.
regeneration.clarifier_sentence: Regeneration clarifier: the pieces are chunky bite-size irregular fish nuggets with a thin crisp cornstarch crust, and on one or two broken pieces the flaky white fish flesh is visible so it clearly reads as fish; not long breaded strips or chicken tenders.
